items.title: Virtual Punya Snan Service
items.text: Arrange Punya Snan in your name at sacred destinations like Ganga.
items.imageAlt: Holy water poured from cupped hands at the river ghat at sunrise
items.bannerImageAlt: Temples and boats on the river ghats at sunrise
items.aboutTitle: A sacred dip, offered in your name
items.aboutText1: Punya Snan is the holy bath taken in a sacred river on an auspicious day. It is believed to cleanse the mind, remove past sins and bring the blessings of the river goddess to the devotee and their family.
items.aboutText2: Many devotees cannot travel to Haridwar, Prayagraj or Varanasi because of distance, health or work. With Virtual Punya Snan, our priests take the sacred dip on your behalf with your name, gotra and photograph, following the full Vedic process.
items.aboutImageAlt: A hand offering flowers on a leaf as holy water falls into the river at sunrise
items.shloka:
गङ्गे च यमुने चैव गोदावरि सरस्वति।
नर्मदे सिन्धु कावेरि जलेऽस्मिन् सन्निधिं कुरु॥

faqs.q: What is a Virtual Punya Snan Service?
faqs.a: A Virtual Punya Snan Service allows devotees to participate remotely in arrangements associated with the sacred bathing tradition when they cannot visit the holy place in person.

faqs.q: Can I book this service if I cannot travel to the holy place?
faqs.a: Yes. This service is intended for devotees who cannot travel because of distance, work, family responsibilities, health concerns, or other personal reasons.

faqs.q: What details are required for the booking?
faqs.a: You may be asked to provide your name, gotra, wish, and photograph for the ritual arrangements. Please follow the booking instructions provided by the service team.

faqs.q: Will I receive a video of the ritual?
faqs.a: Yes. As part of the described service, you receive a recorded video of the ritual so that you can watch it with your family.

faqs.q: Can devotees living outside India use this service?
faqs.a: Devotees living outside India can enquire about availability and booking arrangements. Please confirm the applicable process and payment options before booking.

items.aboutText1: Festivals hold a special place in Hindu traditions. During these occasions, devotees visit temples, attend religious celebrations, and seek blessings from their deities. Festival darshan gives people an opportunity to feel connected to their faith and take part in important religious traditions.

It offers a convenient way to experience live darshan remotely and remain connected to the traditions that matter to them.

items.aboutTitle: What Is Temple Darshan & Offerings Service?
items.aboutText1: Temple darshan is an important part of Hindu religious traditions. Devotees visit temples to offer prayers, seek blessings, and feel connected to their faith. Making offerings is also a meaningful way to express devotion and participate in religious customs associated with different temples and deities.
items.aboutText2: Our Temple Darshan & Offerings Service helps devotees explore available darshan and offering arrangements without managing every detail themselves. You can select the available service, share your requirements, and confirm your booking through a simple process. It offers a convenient option for people who cannot easily travel to a temple but wish to remain connected to their religious traditions.

items.processSubtitle: A simple way to arrange temple darshan and religious offerings.

items.title: Pandit Booking Service
items.text: Find and book pandits for pujas and ceremonies.
items.imageAlt: A pandit reading a sacred text at a wooden desk
items.bannerImageAlt: A priest performing aarti with lamps at the ghat
items.aboutText1: Pandits play an important role in Hindu religious traditions by performing pujas, havans, and other rituals according to established customs. Families often seek a knowledgeable pandit for religious occasions, festivals, ceremonies, and important moments in their lives. Having the right guidance can help them understand the rituals and prepare for the occasion.
items.aboutText2: However, finding a suitable pandit and coordinating the arrangements can sometimes be difficult, especially when you have a busy schedule or live away from your family location. Our Pandit Booking Service helps you explore available booking options according to your religious needs and occasion. You can share your requirements, check the available arrangements, and confirm your booking through a simple process.

items.text: Learn about Hindu traditions, rights and important information.
items.imageAlt: An open scripture with a rudraksha mala beside it
items.bannerImageAlt: A temple on a hill at sunrise
items.aboutText1: Religious awareness helps people understand the traditions, beliefs, customs, and practices that are an important part of Hindu culture. Learning about religious observances, sacred rituals, festivals, and spiritual values can help individuals and families understand the meaning behind different traditions and pass this knowledge on to future generations.
items.aboutText2: Our Religious Awareness Service aims to make information about Hindu traditions and religious practices easier to explore and understand. Whether you want to learn about everyday customs, the significance of rituals, or the values associated with religious observances, this service provides an accessible way to build your understanding of Hindu traditions.

Donations can contribute to initiatives that address community needs, provide essential support, and encourage compassion and social responsibility. Every initiative has its own purpose, and understanding how contributions are used is an important part of responsible giving.

You can review the available information, understand the purpose of an initiative, and follow the provided instructions to enquire about or participate in a suitable opportunity. Our goal is to make it easier for people to learn about meaningful causes and explore ways to contribute.

items.aboutTitle: What Is Graha Shanti & Dosh Nivaran Puja?
items.aboutText1: Graha Shanti and Dosh Nivaran Pujas are performed to seek peace, balance, and positive energy in life. According to Hindu traditions, certain planetary positions and doshas such as Kaal Sarp Dosh, Mangal Dosh, Pitru Dosh or an afflicted Navgraha can create challenges in different areas of life.
items.aboutText2: This service helps you explore and book suitable Graha Shanti and Dosh Nivaran Pujas according to your name and gotra. The puja is performed by experienced priests with proper Vedic procedures and you can also join the puja through live video. It offers a convenient way to seek blessings and perform these important rituals even from your home.
